# uzc_blockstorages (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud block storage volumes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_blockstorages" "all" {}

output "blockstorage_slugs" {
  value = [for v in data.uzc_blockstorages.all.blockstorages : v.slug]
}
```
